compounds.name: acetic acid

ammonia.reason: Short 60-90d age and Lactococcus starter gives minimal amino acid deamination and urea breakdown.

animal_barnyard.reason: Pasteurized milk, clean starter and no surface flora gives no p-cresol, indole or phenol.

bitter.reason: Curd-washing removes lactose and rennet peptides, limiting bitter hydrophobic peptide accumulation.

blue_moldy.reason: No Penicillium roqueforti inoculation so no 2-heptanone, 2-nonanone methyl ketones formed.

browning.reason: Residual lactose/galactose plus lysine undergo Maillard on heating, moderated by curd washing.

buttery.reason: Lactococcus lactis citrate metabolism produces diacetyl/acetoin, mild due to washed curd.

cheesy_sweaty.reason: Very low lipolysis with total FFA ~550 mg/kg gives little free butyric/hexanoic acid.

creaminess.reason: 38% moisture and 32% fat with young intact protein gives smooth, creamy mouthfeel.

crumbliness.reason: High moisture washed-curd elastic body fractures little, no long-age calcium lactate crystals.

firmness.reason: Semi-hard washed curd at pH 5.2 is softer and more open than Cheddar due to higher moisture.

floral_honey.reason: Minimal phenylalanine catabolism to phenylacetaldehyde/2-phenylethanol in short-aged curd.

fruity.reason: Low free fatty acids and esterase activity limit ethyl butanoate/hexanoate ester formation.

goaty.reason: Cow milk only with no caprine branched medium-chain free fatty acids.

malty_nutty.reason: Short aging and low Lactobacillus Strecker activity give little 2-/3-methylbutanal and pyrazines.

melt.reason: pH 5.2 paracasein with solubilized colloidal calcium phosphate flows readily when heated.

mushroom_earthy.reason: No Penicillium/Brevibacterium surface flora so no 1-octen-3-ol or 1-octen-3-one formed.

oil_off.reason: 32% milk fat coalesces moderately on melting but young protein network retains most fat.

smoky.reason: Not smoked, no wood phenols like guaiacol/syringol deposited.

sour_vinegar.reason: Lactic 1720-1950 mg/100g and acetic 119-385 mg/100g present but reduced by lactose removal in washing.

stretch.reason: No pasta-filata hot-water kneading so paracasein fibers do not align into strings.

sulfur_cooked.reason: Minimal methionine catabolism to methanethiol/DMS and no high-cook sulfhydryl retention.

sweet.reason: Washed curd low acidity plus residual lactose/galactose and diacetyl perceived as milky-sweet.

umami.reason: Limited chymosin/plasmin proteolysis in 2-mo cheese gives low free glutamate/aspartate.
